about: Caches trade a bounded set of slots for fewer misses. LRU protects recent keys; LFU protects frequent ones and breaks ties by recency.
outcome: Replay a workload through exact LRU and LFU caches. Inspect evictions, hit rates and the keys each policy protects.
instructions: Load Hot keys and a scan, or edit the labeled inputs below.
Run experiment to execute the Python implementation on your inputs.
Compare a hot key followed by a completely new working set.
